intuition: A duplicate is nearby when the earlier copy remains in the most recent k-index window.

brute_force.approach: Compare every pair of equal values and check their index distance.

optimal.approach: Maintain a set of the last at most k values and test each new value before adding it.

edge_cases: A nonpositive k cannot contain a valid pair.
A one-element array has no duplicate pair.
Remove an item once it falls more than k indices behind.
